verses.en: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
verses.pt: Depois disto manifestou-se Jesus outra vez aos discípulos junto do mar de Tiberíades; e manifestou-se deste modo:
verses.en_web: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.
verses.en_bbe: After these things Jesus let himself be seen again by the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and it came about in this way.

verses.en: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
verses.pt: Estavam juntos Simão Pedro, Tomé, chamado Dídimo, Natanael, que era de Caná da Galiléia, os filhos de Zebedeu, e outros dois dos seus discípulos.
verses.en_web: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.
verses.en_bbe: Simon Peter, Thomas named Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were all together.

verses.en: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes Simão Pedro: Vou pescar. Responderam-lhe: Nós também vamos contigo. Saíram e entraram no barco; e naquela noite nada apanharam.
verses.en_web: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out, and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.
verses.en_bbe: Simon Peter said to them, I am going fishing. They said to him, And we will come with you. They went out and got into the boat; but that night they took no fish.

verses.en: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
verses.pt: Mas ao romper da manhã, Jesus se apresentou na praia; todavia os discípulos não sabiam que era ele.
verses.en_web: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach, yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: Now very early in the morning Jesus was there by the edge of the sea (though the disciples were not conscious that it was Jesus).

verses.en: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes, pois, Jesus: Filhos, não tendes nada que comer? Responderam-lhe: Não.
verses.en_web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”
verses.en_bbe: So Jesus said to them, Children, have you taken any fish? They made answer, No.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes ele: Lançai a rede à direita do barco, e achareis. Lançaram-na, pois, e já não a podiam puxar por causa da grande quantidade de peixes.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Let down the net on the right side of the boat and you will get some. So they put it in the water and now they were not able to get it up again because of the great number of fish.

verses.en: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher’s coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
verses.pt: Então aquele discípulo a quem Jesus amava disse a Pedro: Senhor. Quando, pois, Simão Pedro ouviu que era o Senhor, cingiu-se com a túnica, porque estava despido, e lançou-se ao mar;
verses.en_web: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around him (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.
verses.en_bbe: So the disciple who was dear to Jesus said to Peter, It is the Lord! Hearing that it was the Lord, Peter put his coat round him (because he was not clothed) and went into the sea.

verses.en: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
verses.pt: mas os outros discípulos vieram no barquinho, puxando a rede com os peixes, porque não estavam distantes da terra senão cerca de duzentos côvados.
verses.en_web: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.
verses.en_bbe: And the other disciples came in the little boat (they were not far from land, only about two hundred cubits off) pulling the net full of fish.

verses.en: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
verses.pt: Ora, ao saltarem em terra, viram ali brasas, e um peixe posto em cima delas, e pão.
verses.en_web: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid on it, and bread.
verses.en_bbe: When they got to land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish cooking on it, and bread.

verses.en: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Trazei alguns dos peixes que agora apanhastes.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to them, Get some of the fish which you have now taken.

verses.en: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, and hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
verses.pt: Entrou Simão Pedro no barco e puxou a rede para terra, cheia de cento e cinquenta e três grandes peixes; e, apesar de serem tantos, não se rompeu a rede.
verses.en_web: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of great fish, one hundred fifty-three; and even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
verses.en_bbe: So Peter went to the boat and came back pulling the net to land, full of great fish, a hundred and fifty-three; and though there was such a number the net was not broken.

verses.en: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Vinde, comei. Nenhum dos discípulos ousava perguntar-lhe: Quem és tu? sabendo que era o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast.” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to them, Come and take some food. And all the disciples were in fear of putting the question, Who are you? being conscious that it was the Lord.

verses.en: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.
verses.pt: Chegou Jesus, tomou o pão e deu-lho, e semelhantemente o peixe.
verses.en_web: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and the fish in the same way.

verses.en: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
verses.pt: Foi esta a terceira vez que Jesus se manifestou aos seus discípulos, depois de ter ressurgido dentre os mortos.
verses.en_web: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples, after he had risen from the dead.
verses.en_bbe: Now this was the third time that Jesus let himself be seen by the disciples after he had come back from the dead.

verses.en: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
verses.pt: Depois de terem comido, perguntou Jesus a Simão Pedro: Simão Pedro: Simão, filho de João, amas-me mais do que estes? Respondeu- lhe: Sim, Senhor; tu sabes que te amo. Disse-lhe: Apascenta os meus cordeirinhos.
verses.en_web: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”
verses.en_bbe: Then when they had taken food, Jesus said to Simon Peter, Simon, son of John, is your love for me greater than the love of these others? He said to him, Yes, Lord; you are certain of my love for you. He said to him, Then give my lambs food.

verses.en: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.pt: Tornou a perguntar-lhe: Simão, filho de João, amas-me? Respondeu-lhe: Sim, Senhor; tu sabes que te amo. Disse-lhe: Pastoreia as minhas ovelhas.
verses.en_web: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”
verses.en_bbe: Again, a second time, he said to him, Simon, son of John, have you any love for me? Yes, Lord, he said, you are certain of my love for you. Then take care of my sheep, said Jesus.

verses.en: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.pt: Perguntou-lhe terceira vez: Simão, filho de João, amas-me? Entristeceu-se Pedro por lhe ter perguntado pela terceira vez: Amas- me? E respondeu-lhe: Senhor, tu sabes todas as coisas; tu sabes que te amo. Disse-lhe Jesus: Apascenta as minhas ovelhas.
verses.en_web: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
verses.en_bbe: He said to him a third time, Simon, son of John, am I dear to you? Now Peter was troubled in his heart because he put the question a third time, Am I dear to you? And he said to him, Lord, you have knowledge of all things; you see that you are dear to me. Jesus said to him, Then give my sheep food.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
verses.pt: Em verdade, em verdade te digo que, quando eras mais moço, te cingias a ti mesmo, e andavas por onde querias; mas, quando fores velho, estenderás as mãos e outro te cingirá, e te levará para onde tu não queres.
verses.en_web: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself, and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you, and carry you where you don’t want to go.”
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, When you were young, you made yourself ready and went wherever you had a desire to go: but when you are old, you will put out your hands and another will make you ready, and you will be taken where you have no desire to go.

verses.en: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.pt: Ora, isto ele disse, significando com que morte havia Pedro de glorificar a Deus. E, havendo dito isto, ordenou-lhe: Segue-me.
verses.en_web: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”
verses.en_bbe: Now this he said, pointing out the sort of death by which he would give God glory. And after saying this, he said to him, Come after me.

verses.en: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?
verses.pt: E Pedro, virando-se, viu que o seguia aquele discípulo a quem Jesus amava, o mesmo que na ceia se recostara sobre o peito de Jesus e perguntara: Senhor, quem é o que te trai?
verses.en_web: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ breast at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray You?”
verses.en_bbe: Then Peter, turning round, saw the disciple who was dear to Jesus coming after them--the disciple who was resting on his breast at the last meal, and said, Lord, who is it who will be false to you?

verses.en: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?
verses.pt: Ora, vendo Pedro a este, perguntou a Jesus: Senhor, e deste que será?
verses.en_web: Peter seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
verses.en_bbe: Seeing him, Peter said to Jesus, What about this man?

verses.en: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Se eu quiser que ele fique até que eu venha, que tens tu com isso? Segue-me tu.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to him, If it is my desire for him to be here till I come back, what is that to you? come yourself after me.

verses.en: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?
verses.pt: Divulgou-se, pois, entre os irmãos este dito, que aquele discípulo não havia de morrer. Jesus, porém, não disse que não morreria, mas: se eu quiser que ele fique até que eu venha, que tens tu com isso?
verses.en_web: This saying therefore went out among the brothers, that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”
verses.en_bbe: So this saying went about among the brothers that this disciple would not undergo death: Jesus, however, did not say that he would not undergo death, but, If it is my desire for him to be here till I come back, what is that to you?

verses.en: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
verses.pt: Este é o discípulo que dá testemunho destas coisas e as escreveu; e sabemos que o seu testemunho é verdadeiro.
verses.en_web: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.
verses.en_bbe: This is the disciple who gives witness about these things and who put them in writing: and we have knowledge that his witness is true.

verses.en: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
verses.pt: E ainda muitas outras coisas há que Jesus fez; as quais, se fossem escritas uma por uma, creio que nem ainda no mundo inteiro caberiam os livros que se escrevessem.
verses.en_web: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus did such a number of other things that, if every one was recorded, it is my opinion that even the world itself is not great enough for the books there would be.
